title: The EMN Country Factsheets Structured Dataset
abstract: arXiv:2608.15702v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Each year, the European Migration Network (EMN) country factsheets deliver an overview of key migration and international protection developments within all EMN Member States and observer countries. The factsheets include both a textual component and a visual component. In this paper, we introduce a curated dataset of the textual component of these reports over 35 countries and 13 years (2012-2024.) The dataset was created to facilitate European-level research on migration policies and developments, and promote the use of reliable sources about migration in data science and media research, particularly at a time when the spread of online misinformation about migration constitutes a serious issue. The dataset transforms the original document texts into a tabular format, with columns corresponding to country, year, section, subsection, content, and harmonized title section. translated_title: EMN国家情况说明书结构化数据集
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15702v1 公告类型：新 摘要：每年，欧洲移民网络（EMN）国家情况说明书提供所有EMN成员国和观察员国家关键移民和国际保护发展的概述。这些情况说明书包含文本部分和视觉部分。在本文中，我们介绍了一个精选数据集，涵盖35个国家、13年（2012-2024年）这些报告的文本部分。该数据集旨在促进欧洲层面关于移民政策和发展的研究，并推动在数据科学和媒体研究中使用关于移民的可靠来源，特别是在网上关于移民的错误信息传播构成严重问题的时期。该数据集将原始文档文本转换为表格格式，列对应国家、年份、章节、小节、内容和统一标题部分。我们通过具体分析展示了该数据集的价值。
tldr: 本文构建了一个涵盖35国、2012-2024年间欧洲移民网络国家情况说明书文本的结构化数据集，以支持移民政策研究和打击错误信息。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a structured dataset of European Migration Network country factsheet texts covering 35 countries from 2012 to 2024, aimed at facilitating migration policy research and combating misinformation.
